While each component is documented, correctly combining them and handling the numeric implementation requires careful algorithm design, making it a level-3 conceptual task.
rationale.execution: The pipeline has a few sequential stages (transmission calculation, ZT at one temperature, ZT at multiple temperatures), but all are within a single coherent Python script with no external tooling, data fetching, or complex orchestration. The I/O is simple CSV output. This corresponds to execution difficulty 2.
